brief:
Electronic Intifada reported that Geert Wilders, leader of the Dutch far-right Party for Freedom, has received gifts from figures associated with Israel. The outlet characterized the gift-givers as war criminals and described Wilders as maintaining close relations with Israel lobby groups.

The report highlighted what it characterized as alignment between Wilders' political movement and pro-Israel advocacy organizations in the Netherlands and beyond.
dek: Dutch far right enjoys close relations with Israel lobby.
title: Dutch far-right leader accepts gifts from Israeli officials
